method: Mirrored OPENING_BOOK rows from src/opening/openingBook.ts and computed per-colour Dimension coverage + a selectOpening simulation in node (reports/ scratchpad). Candidate new lines validated for legality + turn-parity with chess.js (worktree node_modules). Measured, not assumed.
key_correction_vs_portfolio: Portfolio PL5 framed the gap as Black-side only. MEASURED reality: the gap is BIDIRECTIONAL. bot=Black (player White) misses {tactics, endgameConversion}; bot=White (player Black) misses {resilience}. Minimal parity therefore needs 2 new Black lines + 1 new White line = 3 new lines (not just 'fill the Black book').

minimal_coverage_set_validated.eco_ground: B12 Caro-Kann ...d5 prefix in eco.json; symmetric pawn structure -> early simplification, mirrors exchangeFrench-w/exchangeSlav-w rationale
C30 King's Gambit prefix in eco.json; bot sacrifices a pawn so the player (Black) must defend/convert under pressure — mirrors the scandi-b/philidor-b resilience rationale for the other colour

rejected_alternatives.reason: Also valid for tactics-as-Black, but starts 1.e4 e5 which overlaps the open-game cluster; sicilian-b gives more colour/structure variety and a cleaner eco match. Kept as a documented alternative, not folded.
Valid endgameConversion-as-Black alternative (D30/QGD Exchange). exchangeCaro-b preferred: 1.e4 keeps the Black book from being all-1.d4-replies and matches the existing Caro entry naming family.
